title: Flow
description: A WhatsApp Flow: an interactive form or menu sent inside a message. `id`, `name`, `status`, `categories` and `validation_errors` are returned by default; the rest only when asked for with the `fields` query parameter.

id.description: The unique ID of the Flow.

name.description: User-defined Flow name. Not visible to WhatsApp users.

status.description: DRAFT: under development, sendable only with `"mode": "draft"`. PUBLISHED: sendable, and can no longer be deleted or updated. DEPRECATED: retired; cannot be sent or opened. BLOCKED and THROTTLED: set by endpoint health monitoring.

categories.description: Business use cases this Flow covers.

json_version.description: Flow JSON version of the uploaded asset.

data_api_version.description: Data API version of the uploaded asset. Flows with an endpoint only.

endpoint_uri.description: URL of the WhatsApp Flow Endpoint.

whatsapp_business_account.description: The WABA that owns the Flow.

application.description: The Meta app the Flow was created with.
